notes.title: Shotgun, Sneak, and AI Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624516/daab635f05dba55b5596ff5d03324532b7b593fb.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624516/dacf3dbdd82f7cbffdb09aebc4bd8d514b3a5b68.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624516/982e47e5a0044db1e5f1184d6b857d9e9ae0a9a3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624516/ecaf0c7a30688439a5a2a856b31acdcdeb48b2c5.png


New Content:

 Added a shotgun (with sound effects and animations)
 Added a sneak/crouch mechanic making it more difficult to be detected by aliens
 Updated pathfinding of aliens
 Added enemy ragdoll upon death by shotgun
 Added a ammo mechanic
 Created a feature to randomly scatter ammo across the farm house area
 Added a shotgun wall mount to the house
 Player can now escape the alien's chase 


Changes: 

 Flashlight will no longer stun enemies
 Increased player sprint speed
 Decreased player walk speed
 Enemy will crawl for a longer distance before turning to a run


Fixes:

 Fixed animation loops that would sometimes occur in scout alien

notes.title: Gameplay Changes and hotfixes
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/44hviam.png

Gameplay Changes:

 Changed prompt on alien spires/towers from "press" to "tap"
 Changed the amount of times the player needs to "tap" E in order to disable spires. making it less difficult
 Changed the fonts and design of final screen


Fixes:

 Fixed a bug where number of spires would not reset upon players death
 Fixed a bug where player could use the hint when entering Final screen

notes.title: Content Update #2
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/44hviam.png
Features & Changes

 Made it so the TV only plays upon first entering the gam (TV will be off upon respawning)
 Added a hint system to help guide players to destinations and to help those who get lost
 Added another alien spire in the driveway (hopefully enticing players to approach it)
 Added a spotlight from spire so players know where to interact with
 Increased the patrol radius of the armored alien variant
 Removed some scout aliens to make the game less difficult
 Updated all the UI and menus
 Changed some post-processing effects
 Decreased cornfield density

Bugs Fixed

 Fixed areas where wall barrier had no collider (which allowed players to leave the map
 Fixed some colliders on objects that were not acting correctly
